    Chain facts for BO13a Lemma 6 #

    • Crown.ftm_of_rayMor_eq, Crown.long_meets: every long morphism divides an entry of the chain of a crown (crown_meets).
    • Crown.ρ_add_two_mul, Crown.σ_add_two_mul, Crown.weight_chain: for crowns of length four.
    • MulBasis.l6_caseI_i: case I.2.c with ρₙ' ≫ u₂' ≠ 0 (then n = 2), abstractly: from depth σ₂ ≤ depth (ρₙ' ≫ u₂') and the fact that long morphisms divide crown entries.

    BO13a Lemma 6, case I.2.c with ρₙ' ≫ u₂' ≠ 0. Here σ₂ is transported to the common domain x' of ρₙ; hdep comes from the minimality of the crown and hlongs from long_meets (both for a crown of length four).
